requiredBeforeFiling.printedContext: Mailing address of the agency the demand is sent to
requiredBeforeFiling.disclosureLabel: Mailing address of the agency the demand is sent to
requiredBeforeFiling.why: the platform holds no address for the agency and it is never guessed
requiredBeforeFiling.participantMustSupply: the agency's current published mailing address

requiredBeforeFiling.printedContext: Agency the demand is addressed to - the agency whose records have not been conformed
requiredBeforeFiling.disclosureLabel: Agency the demand is addressed to - the agency whose records have not been conformed
requiredBeforeFiling.why: which agency failed to conform its records is a fact the participant establishes by checking, and the platform has not seen the results
requiredBeforeFiling.participantMustSupply: the agency that still shows the record - the State Patrol, a county attorney, a court records office, a city attorney, or another; your State Patrol report, court case search or courthouse terminal printout shows which

requiredBeforeFiling.printedContext: Date of arrest, citation or referral
requiredBeforeFiling.disclosureLabel: Date of arrest, citation or referral
requiredBeforeFiling.why: no arrest fact is held for a record the platform has not seen
requiredBeforeFiling.participantMustSupply: the date you were arrested, cited or referred, from your papers

requiredBeforeFiling.printedContext: Case or citation number, if there was one
requiredBeforeFiling.disclosureLabel: Case or citation number, if there was one
requiredBeforeFiling.why: no case identifier is held for a record the platform has not seen
requiredBeforeFiling.participantMustSupply: the case or citation number, copied from the record if one exists

requiredBeforeFiling.printedContext: How the matter ended - no charges filed, diversion completed, dismissed, or acquitted - and the date it ended
requiredBeforeFiling.disclosureLabel: How the matter ended - no charges filed, diversion completed, dismissed, or acquitted - and the date it ended
requiredBeforeFiling.why: no disposition fact is held for a record the platform has not seen
requiredBeforeFiling.participantMustSupply: how the matter ended and on what date, from the court record or your papers - the qualifying dispositions are those Neb. Rev. Stat. Sec. 29-3523(3) lists

requiredBeforeFiling.printedContext: Date on which the period applicable to that kind of disposition ran out, or the event that ended it
requiredBeforeFiling.disclosureLabel: Date on which the period applicable to that kind of disposition ran out, or the event that ended it
requiredBeforeFiling.why: the computation depends on dates the platform does not hold, so the participant computes it from the record
requiredBeforeFiling.participantMustSupply: when the Sec. 29-3523(3) period for your kind of disposition ran out, or the event that ended it, computed from the record

requiredBeforeFiling.printedContext: How the record was verified as still publicly appearing, and the date checked
requiredBeforeFiling.disclosureLabel: How the record was verified as still publicly appearing, and the date checked
requiredBeforeFiling.why: the evidence that the record is still public is the participant's own search, which the platform has not seen
requiredBeforeFiling.participantMustSupply: how you checked - a Nebraska State Patrol report, a court case search, or a courthouse public-access terminal printout - and the date you checked

requiredBeforeFiling.printedContext: Date of arrest, citation or referral, on the complaint
requiredBeforeFiling.disclosureLabel: Date of arrest, citation or referral, on the complaint
requiredBeforeFiling.why: no arrest fact is held for a record the platform has not seen
requiredBeforeFiling.participantMustSupply: the same arrest, citation or referral date as on the demand letter

requiredBeforeFiling.printedContext: Case or citation number, if there was one, on the complaint
requiredBeforeFiling.disclosureLabel: Case or citation number, if there was one, on the complaint
requiredBeforeFiling.why: no case identifier is held for a record the platform has not seen
requiredBeforeFiling.participantMustSupply: the same case or citation number as on the demand letter, if one exists

requiredBeforeFiling.printedContext: Name of the agency or political subdivision sued, and its mailing address
requiredBeforeFiling.disclosureLabel: Name of the agency or political subdivision sued, and its mailing address
requiredBeforeFiling.why: which public body failed to comply is a fact the participant establishes, and the platform has not seen the searches
requiredBeforeFiling.participantMustSupply: the non-compliant agency or political subdivision, named as your searches show it, with its current published mailing address

requiredBeforeFiling.printedContext: Date the written demand was delivered, and what response was received
requiredBeforeFiling.disclosureLabel: Date the written demand was delivered, and what response was received
requiredBeforeFiling.why: what happened to the demand is post-generation history only the participant knows
requiredBeforeFiling.participantMustSupply: when your demand letter was delivered to the agency and what, if anything, the agency answered - the complaint is conditional on the demand not producing compliance

requiredBeforeFiling.printedContext: How the matter ended and the date, on the complaint
requiredBeforeFiling.disclosureLabel: How the matter ended and the date, on the complaint
requiredBeforeFiling.why: no disposition fact is held for a record the platform has not seen
requiredBeforeFiling.participantMustSupply: the same disposition and date as on the demand letter

requiredBeforeFiling.printedContext: Date the applicable Sec. 29-3523(3) period ran out, or its trigger, on the complaint
requiredBeforeFiling.disclosureLabel: Date the applicable Sec. 29-3523(3) period ran out, or its trigger, on the complaint
requiredBeforeFiling.why: the computation depends on dates the platform does not hold
requiredBeforeFiling.participantMustSupply: the same computed date or event as on the demand letter

requiredBeforeFiling.printedContext: County in the caption - the district where the records are located, or Lancaster County, as you elect
requiredBeforeFiling.disclosureLabel: County in the caption - the district where the records are located, or Lancaster County, as you elect
requiredBeforeFiling.why: Neb. Rev. Stat. Sec. 29-3528 grants a venue choice the route does not determine, and only the participant can make it
requiredBeforeFiling.participantMustSupply: the county of the district court you elect - a district where the records are located, or Lancaster County; the statute allows both and the venue election guidance explains the choice, which is yours

requiredBeforeFiling.printedContext: How the plaintiff verified the record still appears publicly, on the complaint
requiredBeforeFiling.disclosureLabel: How the plaintiff verified the record still appears publicly, on the complaint
requiredBeforeFiling.why: the evidence is the participant's own search, which the platform has not seen
requiredBeforeFiling.participantMustSupply: the same verification as on the demand letter, updated if you checked again before filing

protectedBlanks.label: Signature on the demand letter
protectedBlanks.why: the letter is the participant's own and is signed when actually posted

protectedBlanks.label: Date beside the signature on the letter
protectedBlanks.why: a date written before the letter is actually posted would be false

protectedBlanks.label: Case number of this action, assigned at filing
protectedBlanks.why: the district court's office assigns the number at filing

protectedBlanks.label: Signature of the plaintiff on the complaint
protectedBlanks.why: the plaintiff signs the complaint personally

protectedBlanks.label: Date beside the plaintiff's signature on the complaint
protectedBlanks.why: a date written before the complaint is signed would be false
